# Backspace Fork 1.16.8

## Juno: rare memory-curse card

- Added one rare Alzheimer card with the supplied cosmic artwork and audio.
  It can be played over any color or number without changing the active color.
- The next player alone loses visibility of their hand, middle card and active
  color. Choose one card blind: a legal play lifts the curse and plays normally;
  a miss keeps the chosen card, draws two and passes. Timeout also draws two.
- Hidden hands use server-redacted opaque slots, not CSS-blurred card images.
  Normal draw/pass cannot bypass the curse; blind wilds keep the inherited color
  and wild +4 retains its existing restriction.
- Added localized hidden-card labels, rules and miss feedback in five languages,
  reduced-motion support and once-only audio through existing SFX/deafen controls.
- Enhanced rounds have 109 cards only when every human client supports the rule.
  Mixed or legacy cohorts keep the classic 108-card deck. An unsupported client
  cannot bypass hiding by downgrading its request; leaving remains available.

The 1.16.7 live-game recovery/rate-limit protections remain in place. Permissions,
federated identity, scoring and practice rules are unchanged. No database
migration is required. Restarting Backspace discards ephemeral active tables;
persisted scores and user data remain preserved. Reload/update clients to enable
enhanced rounds. This release does not require restarting LiveKit.
